verdict.rationale: The spec documents a thin execution-control mechanism (an experimental 'allowed-tools' frontmatter field constraining what tools a skill may use) and describes discovery/loading behavior, but there is no dedicated security-posture document, no explicit trust model for vetting third-party skill authors, and no first-party telemetry/data-collection disclosure — in fact, community commentary reveals the leaderboard's telemetry-based ranking is undocumented and was called 'misleading' by users. missing for 10: a dedicated security/trust documentation page, an explained vetting process for third-party skills, and a first-party telemetry/privacy disclosure.
